scope: Development-only clean-room diagnostic of the circular-frequency factor in the published pre-NQC (2,2) amplitude. No production, catalog, historical-fidelity, or release claim.
sources: Barausse and Buonanno, arXiv:0912.3517, equatorial Eqs. (161)-(164)
Barausse and Buonanno, arXiv:1107.2904, Eqs. (50)-(52); Taracchini et al., arXiv:1311.2544, aligned-spin calibration
method: At fixed radius and angular momentum set p_r*=0, evaluate the Hamiltonian's metric and spin-map scalars, and derive d(H_eff/mu)/d(p_phi/mu) analytically by the chain rule. Divide by H_real/M. Compare with Torch and JAX native autodiff paths. Use centered differences of the native effective Hamiltonian only as a step-size diagnostic, not as the proposed evaluator.
gradient_checks: analytic circular frequency and current Torch/JAX circular frequency at fixed states
autodiff radius and angular-momentum gradients of analytic circular frequency against JAX's current path
published (2,2) amplitude and its radius derivative when fed either circular frequency
limitations: States are fixed diagnostic inputs, not circular solutions or evolved trajectories. Shared native potential and spin-map expressions are not an independent paper transcription. This does not test historical implementation conventions or release suitability.
